verdict.rationale: Community reports confirm an opt-out path exists (env vars/account settings) for disabling automatically-enabled data collection like log forwarding and JFR profiling, but these features were turned on by default without clear consent and customers found support unhelpful in filtering/disabling unwanted telemetry. There is no first-party documentation of a dedicated privacy/telemetry opt-out control, especially for the AI assistant's own usage tracking. Missing for 10: explicit documented opt-out settings for AI-assistant usage data, first-party privacy controls page, and evidence the opt-out is easy/reliable rather than a workaround discovered via forum complaints.
